basics.name: Kevin Ndayishimiye
basics.label: Presidential Scholar, B.S. in Computer Science Student

work.name: Castner Incorporated
highlights: Contributed to academic research on disaster relief, focusing on preparedness for older adults and African American/Black communities.
Wrote programs in R to manage and analyze the Federal Emergency Management Agency (FEMA) National Household Survey database.
Developed accessible explanations of machine learning concepts for general audiences.
Canvassed thousands of community members to build support for the restoration of Humboldt Parkway.
Fundraised hundreds of thousands of dollars to support a legal battle with the New York State Department of Transportation (NYSDOT).
Successfully won an injunction that required an Environmental Impact Statement (EIS) from the NYSDOT.

publications.name: Co-author: Disaster Preparedness Interventions via Machine Learning on FEMA National Household Survey Data
publications.publisher: International Journal of Environmental Research and Public Health
publications.summary: Contributed to a machine learning model that identified key factors in household disaster preparedness for older adults and African American/Black communities.
highlights: The model analyzed 252 variables from over 15,000 participants in the FEMA National Household Survey.
The findings highlighted the need for targeted interventions to support financial resilience and equitable resource access.

projects.name: Prediction Market Arbitrage Tracker
projects.summary: Engineered a system to compare order books and execute trades based on identified pricing inefficiencies.
highlights: Utilized WebSocket (WSS) and REST APIs to stream real-time order book data from prediction markets like Kalshi and Polymarket.

projects.name: SpadesAI
projects.summary: Developed a non-deterministic algorithm for playing the card game Spades, using a combination of deep learning and Monte Carlo Tree Search (MCTS).
highlights: Achieved a 2100 Elo rating in Competitive Online Spades games.

projects.name: UrbanClass
projects.summary: Built a system to classify communities as urban, suburban, or rural based on both self-identification and data markers.
highlights: The classification data is being used to help build election models for the 2026 and 2028 U.S. elections.

projects.name: Avatar Platform Fighter
projects.summary: Collaborated an in a team of four to create Avatar: The Last Airbender themed platform fighting game for the 2025 BisonBytes Hackathon.
highlights: Specific role was writing the core game logic in GDScript and JavaScript.
